verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents a dedicated Memory Export feature that produces structured exports of memories using customizable Pydantic schemas, which is a machine-readable export path. The open-source edition adds a further hedge against lock-in, since you own the stack and the data. missing for 10: explicit output format details (e.g. JSON/file download), evidence of full-store bulk export and re-import elsewhere, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can export memories in a machine-readable format so the memory store is portable and not a lock-in trap

citations.quote: The Memory Export feature allows you to create structured exports of memories using customizable Pydantic schemas.
